lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Cu2Si2 (Mg6CuSi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows all Cu, Mg, and Si centers adopting 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 3.05–3.30 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate that 12-vertex Mg-centered coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
